appearance.headerSub: Customize how OpusLex looks on your device.

fontSize.description: Choose how large application text should appear. The scale maintains typographic hierarchy throughout the application.

density.description: Control how much space interface elements use.

landing.title: Default landing section
landing.description: Choose the section that opens immediately after you log in.

accessibility.headerSub: Adjust the interface to suit your needs.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Minimizes animations and transitions across the entire application, including the login background.

largerTargets.label: Larger click targets
largerTargets.description: Increases the padding on interactive controls for easier interaction.

highContrast.label: High contrast
highContrast.description: Increases text and border contrast across the application.

accessibility.osPreference: Reduce motion also respects your operating system's motion preference.
